name: fusion-optimizer
description: Universal coding agent plugin — balances quality methodology and cost optimization across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, and AGENTS.md tools. Smart mode arbitration: ZEN (cost), BALANCED (default), QUALITY (methodology).

interface.shortDescription: Smart quality/cost auto-balance — works with any coding agent
interface.longDescription: Fusion Optimizer detects task complexity and automatically selects the right balance of quality methodology and cost optimization. ZEN mode for simple tasks (65% token savings), BALANCED for features (40% savings + TDD), QUALITY for architecture (25% savings + full methodology). Works across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, and all AGENTS.md-compatible tools.
